definitions.short: Tubal , a postdiluvian patriarch and his posterity
definitions.full: H8422. Tubal תּוּבַל proper name, of a territory and people in east Asia Minor , perhaps nearly = Cappadocia ( = Assyrian Tabalu Dl Pa 250 f. COT Genesis 10. 2, cf Di Gen 10:2 ); — ׳ת Isa 66:19 ; Ezek 27:13 , תֻּבַל 32:26 , תֻּבָ֫ל Gen 10:2 = 1Chr 1:5 ; Ezek 38:2-3 , 39:1 ; Θοβελ .
definitions.rootNote: or תֻּבַל ; probably of foreign derivation;
